# Community Rule Column 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 6 | **Condition:** complete

---

**6:1** And also, let no man bring a matter against his neighbor before the-Many without having first reproved him before witnesses.

**6:2** In these ways they shall walk in all their dwelling-places. Everyone who is found with another shall obey the junior the-senior in work and in property.

**6:3** Together they shall eat, and together they shall bless, and together they shall take-counsel. In every place where there are ten men-of

**6:4** the-council-of the-community, let there not be-absent from them a man who-is-a-priest. And each according-to his rank shall sit before him, and thus

**6:5** they shall be asked for their counsel regarding every matter. And when they set-the-table to eat or the new-wine

**6:6** to drink, the priest shall stretch-out his hand first to bless the-first-portion-of the bread and the new-wine.

**6:7** And in the-place where the ten are, let there not be-absent a man who-studies the Torah day

**6:8** and night, continually, each-one relieving another. And the-Many shall keep-watch together for a third-of every night-of

**6:9** the year, to read in the-Book and to study judgment and to bless together.

**6:10** This is the-rule for the-session-of the-Many. Each-man in his place: first the priests, and second the elders, and then all

**6:11** the-rest-of the people shall sit, each in his place. And thus they shall be asked regarding judgment and regarding every counsel and matter

**6:12** that comes before the-Many, so-that each-man may give his knowledge to the-council-of the-community.

**6:13** Let no man speak in the-midst-of the-words-of his neighbor, before his brother has finished speaking. And also let him not speak

**6:14** before his rank that-is-written before him. The man who is asked shall speak in his turn. And in the-session-of

**6:15** the-Many let no man speak any word without the-consent-of the-Many. And if

**6:16** the-man who-is the-Instructor over the-Many — if any man has a word to say to the-Many

**6:17** but is not in the-position-of the one-who-asks the-council-of the-community, that man shall stand on his feet

**6:18** and say: "I have a word to speak to the-Many." If they tell him, he shall speak.

**6:19** And every-man-of Israel who volunteers to join the-council-of the-community,

**6:20** the-Instructor who-is at the-head-of the-Many shall examine him regarding his understanding and his deeds. If he is suited-for instruction,

**6:21** he shall bring him into the covenant to turn to the truth and to turn-away from all injustice. And he shall instruct him in all the-judgments-of the-community.

**6:22** And afterward, when he comes to stand before the-Many, they shall all be asked regarding his affairs.

**6:23** And as the-lot falls by the-council-of the-Many, he shall draw-near or keep-far. And when he draws-near to the-council-of the-community,

**6:24** he shall not touch the-purity-of the-Many until they examine him regarding his spirit and his deeds, until he has completed a full year.

**6:25** And also he shall not share in the-property-of the-Many.

**6:26** When he has completed one year within the-community, the-Many shall inquire regarding his affairs, regarding his understanding and his deeds in the Torah. And if the-lot falls to him to draw-near to the-council-of the-community, by the-authority-of the priests and the-multitude-of the-men-of the-covenant,

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Hebrew text of 1QS Column 6 (Cave 1, complete). "The-Many" (ha-rabbim) preserved as sectarian technical term throughout. "Instructor" renders mebaqqer. "Purity" (tohorat) refers to the community's ritually pure food and drink. "New-wine" (tirosh) distinguished from standard wine (yayin).*
